author: WPB5
summary: Alpha.1-era research audit (CNA 7a64362e) of platform support: an evidence ladder per platform, renderer gates per platform, sixty facts on toolchains, Wine, MSVC, Apple, CI, web, Android and how platform code is distributed, CNA-document contradictions and a book plan. Much of it is stale at 009d40f5 (a real platform layer with seven implementations, 25 renderers, iOS and macOS CI, fixed CI lanes). The platform deep dives already carry the current material. Residue added: the native Linux controller-mapping database, the phone back-buffer orientation rule and the 32-bit arithmetic lane.

concepts.text: Linux x86_64 is the only self-hosting target; every other platform is cross-compiled from Linux and run under a translation layer (Wine/DXVK, headless Chromium, an Android emulator) or not run at all, and no CNA binary had been shown on genuine Windows, macOS, iOS or Android hardware.

concepts.text: CNA has no platform abstraction layer by explicit policy; platform variation is expressed as CMake target selection, and SDL3 itself is the abstraction.
